cartridges.name: .24 Nosler

source.name: The Ballistic Assistant, SAAMI Rifle Cartridge Catalog

cartridges.note: That page prints bullet diameter .2435 to .2415, max case 1.600, COAL 2.135 to 2.260, head diameter .378, and MAP 55,000 psi (not CUP). Trim is printed there as 1.580, but Hodgdon prints 1.590 and Handloader prints a trim-to of 1.590, so trimLength is null. ANSI/SAAMI Z299.4-2025 has no 24 Nosler drawing. Nosler CASE HOLDS under the bullet differs by sheet: 55 gr 29.0, 70 gr 28.8, 80 gr 27.1, 85/90 gr 26.5, 105 gr 25.8.

cartridges.name: .26 Nosler

cartridges.name: .27 Nosler
cartridges.note: Replaces our loads.json 27-nosler record; keep its capacity. PTG chamber drawing BOP-10948, 27 NOSLER SAAMI (PTG own print, not a Z299.4 sheet), from the bolt face. 4D page has no drawing. GROOVE SIZE .2770. Body 0.5533 in at the bolt face, 0.5510 in at 0.200. Shoulder 0.5292 in at 35 deg at 2.1043 in. Neck 0.3160 in at 2.2566 in, 0.039 over the bullet. Print case 2.6000 in; library case 2.590 stays. Capacity 98.4 gr H2O is from Nosler (https://www.nosler.com/explore/nosler-cartridges/27-nosler-rifle-cartridge, retrieved 2026-10-28); max COAL 3.34 is the library value. PTG prints chamber dimensions: 2.6000 in is the chamber length to the neck end, not a case length, so it is not stored as the case length (library case 2.59 stays). PTG's own reamer print used although titled SAAMI (owner ruling 2026-10-29). caseLength 2.590 in from Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nosler_cartridges, .27 Nosler infobox).

cartridges.name: .33 Nosler
cartridges.note: Fills the empty profile of library 33-nosler. 4D page image is a bushing photo. PTG drawing BOP-11028, 33 NOSLER SAAMI (PTG own print), from the bolt face. GROOVE SIZE .3380. Chamber body 0.5533 in at the bolt face, 0.5510 at 0.200. Shoulder 0.5303 in at 35 deg at 2.0115 in; neck 0.3720 in at 2.1246 in; 2.4700 in to the chamber neck end. PTG prints chamber dimensions: 2.4700 in is the chamber length to the neck end, not a case length, so it is not stored as the case length (library case 2.46 stays). PTG's own reamer print used although titled SAAMI (owner ruling 2026-10-29). caseLength 2.460 in and max COAL 3.340 in from Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nosler_cartridges, .33 Nosler infobox).

cartridges.name: .375 Weatherby Magnum
cartridges.note: 4D page has no drawing. PTG drawing PTG-11076, 375 WBY MAG SAAMI (PTG own print); groove 0.3760. Lengths are printed from the belt datum; the print gives the datum as 0.2200 min / 0.2240 max from the bolt face, so 0.2200 was added to put them on the case head: shoulder 0.4960 in at 2.1870 -> 2.4070 in; neck 0.4070 in at 2.3437 -> 2.5637 in. Body 0.5136 in (0.5140 just ahead of the belt); belt recess 0.5340 in. Weatherby radius shoulder (R.1820/R.1200, 45 deg chord printed), so no angle stored. PTG prints chamber dimensions: 2.6550 in from the datum (2.8750 from the head) is the chamber length to the neck end, not a case length, so it is not stored as the case length; the print gives no case trim length. PTG's own reamer print used although titled SAAMI (owner ruling 2026-10-29). caseLength 2.860 in and max COAL 3.600 in from Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/.375_Weatherby_Magnum).
